# LooteerV3

A Diablo IV loot automation plugin for QQT. The
client is a thin consumer of a cloud-managed item catalog — all classification
logic lives on the server, so adding a new category or fixing a misclassified
item never requires a client update.

## Architecture

```
   ┌──────────────────┐    HTTP    ┌──────────────────────┐
   │ looter-d4share   │ ─────────▶ │  core/updater.lua    │
   │ (Linux + Docker) │   curl     │  (60s auto-sync)     │
   │ pipeline.py      │            └──────────┬───────────┘
   │ d4data + Wowhead │                       │ writes
   └──────────────────┘                       ▼
                                   ┌──────────────────┐
                                   │ data/items.lua   │
                                   │ data/config.lua  │
                                   └────────┬─────────┘
                                            │ require()
                                            ▼
                                   ┌──────────────────┐
                                   │ LooteerV3 (Lua)  │
                                   │ inside QQT       │
                                   └──────────────────┘
```

The catalog (`data/items.lua`) is generated by the server pipeline from
d4data + Wowhead, then served at
`/d4/items.lua`. It carries:

- The per-item map: `{n=name, g=group, t=item_type, r=rarity_tier}`.
- Special tables: `ubers`, `boss_materials`, `event_items`.
- The `name_patterns` table — substring/Lua-pattern fallbacks for runtime drops
  that don't appear in d4data (compass, heavenly sigil, goblin cache events).

## Features

- **Cloud-driven classification** — categories and patterns are server data,
  not hardcoded Lua. The plugin auto-syncs every 60 s via QQT's built-in curl.
- **Catalog-mandatory** — the loot engine refuses to act if `data/items.lua`
  isn't present. The repo ships a pre-built copy so a fresh checkout is
  immediately functional; the GUI exposes a one-shot `Load / Reload Catalog`
  button that picks up new versions without restarting the script.
- **Per-category rarity** — every loot category whose items span multiple
  rarities (charm, cube, seal, sigil, compass, tribute, rune, gemstone, cache,
  scroll, recipe, crafting, boss drops) has its own minimum-rarity dropdown
  next to its toggle.
- **Set rarity** — charm dropdown carries a Set tier (charms are the only
  category that drops at runtime rarity 7).
- **Always-loot opt-outs** — V2's hardcoded "always loot" list (ubers, keys,
  XP motes, glyphs, misc trinkets, boss drops) is now a tree of toggles, all
  default ON. Useful on alts where you don't care about a category.
- **Per-slot GA thresholds** — independent Greater Affix counts for every
  weapon/armor slot, gated by a master `Force Per-Slot Settings` toggle.
- **Web admin** — server ships a Bootstrap admin UI for browsing, filtering
  by group/special/rarity, and overriding individual item classifications.

## Requirements

- QQT
- Diablo IV (PC)
- A reachable looter-d4share catalog server
  (default: `http://192.168.10.91:8002`). Edit `Updater.bat` to point at your
  own deployment.

## Installation

1. Clone or copy this repo into your QQT `scripts` directory:
   ```
   <QQT install>/scripts/LooteerV3/
   ```
2. Launch QQT and enable **LooteerV3** in the plugin list.

On the first tick the plugin auto-generates a profile key, registers with the
server, and fetches the latest `items.lua` and `config.lua`. It re-syncs every
60 seconds in the background — no external process needed.

The repo ships a pre-built `data/items.lua` so the catalog is available
immediately even before the first sync completes.

## In-game GUI

All settings live in the QQT in-game menu under `LooteerV3`. Top-level layout:

- **Header** — current catalog version + age. Shows `!! CATALOG NOT LOADED !!`
  in red if `data/items.lua` is missing.
- **Enable** — master toggle.
- **Load / Reload Catalog** — triggers an immediate curl fetch; shows
  "Fetching..." while in flight. Auto-syncs every 60 s otherwise.
- **Use Web Config** — apply settings downloaded from the admin web UI's
  per-profile config link.
- **General Settings** — behavior (Always / Orbwalk), distance, equipment
  rarity, loot priority (nearest / best).
- **Affix Settings** — global Legendary / Unique / Uber GA thresholds, plus
  per-slot overrides under `Force Per-Slot Settings`.
- **Always-Loot Categories** — opt-outs for ubers, boss drops, misc trinkets,
  XP powerups, glyph drops, keys (defaults ON).
- **Item Types** — toggles + min-rarity dropdowns for every loot category.
- **Charm / Cube Item / Seal Settings** — per-category toggle + rarity (charm
  dropdown includes Set).
- **Debug** — wireframe for inspected items, scan-and-print of nearby drops.

## File structure

```
LooteerV3/
├── main.lua              # entry point, loot loop, plugin API
├── gui.lua               # in-game menu
├── core/
│   ├── item_filter.lua   # catalog lookup → group → loot-engine category
│   ├── loot_engine.lua   # rarity / inventory / GA gates
│   ├── updater.lua       # async curl sync (items.lua, config.lua, profile key)
│   ├── pathfinder.lua    # movement to drops
│   ├── renderer.lua      # on-screen overlay
│   └── settings.lua      # reads the GUI elements every frame
├── utils/
│   └── utils.lua
└── data/
    ├── defaults.lua      # bundled fallback (empty catalog, empty patterns)
    ├── items.lua         # cloud catalog — fetched by Updater.bat
    ├── profile.key       # generated on first Updater run (gitignored)
    └── config.lua        # downloaded from /api/config/<key> (gitignored)
```
